plain.text: Joseph could no longer control himself. He sent everyone else out and wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard. "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" His brothers were terrified and could not answer. Joseph said, "Come close to me. I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt! Do not be distressed or angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you." There would be five more years of famine. "God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance. So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God."

Joseph told them to hurry back to his father: "God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don't delay. You will live in the region of Goshen, near me, and I will provide for you." He threw his arms around Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept on his shoulder. He kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterwards his brothers talked with him.

Pharaoh was pleased to hear Joseph's brothers had come. He told Joseph to send carts for their children and wives and bring their father, promising them the best of the land of Egypt. Joseph gave them carts and provisions, new clothes, and to Benjamin three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes. He sent his father donkeys loaded with good things. As they left he said, "Don't quarrel on the way!"

They went back to Canaan and told Jacob, "Joseph is still alive! He is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned and did not believe them. But when they told him everything Joseph had said, and he saw the carts Joseph had sent, his spirit revived. "Enough! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."

summary.bigIdea: Joseph reveals himself and forgives his brothers, seeing God's hand in everything: "It was to save lives that God sent me before you."
points: Joseph weeps and tells his brothers, "I am Joseph!"
He forgives them, seeing that God used even their evil to save lives.
Jacob hears Joseph is alive, and his spirit revives.
summary.reflection: Joseph saw God at work even in the wrong done to him. Is there a painful part of your story where God might bring good?
